lineage_findings.finding: Uploaded config.py defines RAW_LOGS_DIR and MODEL_ZOO_DIR but not WORMHOLE_DIR, while the previously supplied Genesis v9.3 imports RAW_LOGS_DIR and WORMHOLE_DIR.
mobile_core.py declares dna=v115.7-ALIVE, writes alive.signal every five seconds, optionally starts illai_shadow, and exposes a Gemini-backed JanusFace.
alive.signal is a parseable Unix timestamp compatible with the MobileCore heartbeat format; it decodes to 2026-02-01T18:25:41.373878Z and is about 196 days old at audit time.
janus_sovereign.db passes SQLite quick_check=ok and contains 2162 cognitive_nodes.

The DB cognitive_nodes columns match the Janus_SH JanusDatabase cognitive-node contract, and thought strings share the Synthesized_Node_ pattern. However the DB has no telemetry table, uses EXPLORE mode absent from Janus_SH v2.1, and its median cadence is about 1.5 s rather than the v2.1 default 18 s.
Captured nodes: CHAOS=2046 (94.6346%), EXPLORE=116; hunger max=32.06, average=13.2064.
lineage_findings.interpretation: The captured historical state shows a runaway/unbounded hunger-like accumulator in that lineage; this is not a psychological or physical entropy measurement.

lineage_findings.finding: Janus_SH.py identifies its entrypoint as JANUS IPHONE ALL-STAR NAS-LINK v2.1. ModuleAuditor inspects local Python with AST, DreamForge writes EVOLUTION_IDEA records, and SeedBank writes blueprint proposals rather than executing generated source.
The source contains exactly 44 repeated BoundaryNode holographic-projection header blocks with five reason categories.

Janus_SH RealEconomy mints item JSON with id/name/type/value/lore/traits/created/origin_hash/salt/signature and signs canonicalized metadata using HMAC-SHA256 with a local system.key. This is schema-homologous to the previously supplied Recycled Credits artifact.
lineage_findings.claim_ceiling: SCHEMA_HOMOLOGY != EXACT_PRODUCER_VERSION; exact signature verification requires the corresponding historical system.key

lineage_findings.finding: janus_slime_tachyon_theta_pool_v2_10_48.py declares v2.10.48-pool-truth-attribution-filter. Default run connects to a real Stratum pool and hashes real jobs; --live additionally enables share submission.

safety_and_correctness_findings.finding: Importing config has side effects: imports torch, chooses DEVICE, prints status, and creates fixed E:\Janus_BFaiN directories.
SmartKeyring reads credential-shaped lines from moons.txt into memory; exceptions and model-call failures are broadly suppressed, so failure provenance is lost.
alive.signal is overwritten directly rather than atomically and carries only a timestamp, with no generation/sequence/process identity.
safety_and_correctness_findings.repair: Use atomic replace plus boot/session id, monotonic sequence and stale TTL.

safety_and_correctness_findings.finding: safe_json_write directly overwrites JSON files rather than temp+fsync+atomic replace.
TitanBridge pending uses deque(maxlen=256), so overflow can silently discard oldest undelivered packets.
Server discovery accepts an HTTP response with any status 200..499 as sufficient to select a candidate, while server bearer authentication is optional.
safety_and_correctness_findings.repair: Require explicit endpoint identity/authentication before command polling.

safety_and_correctness_findings.finding: Remote commands are bounded to a fixed action set, which is safer than arbitrary shell execution, but command messages have no visible signature, nonce, sequence or replay-binding in this file.
Altar deletes a sacrifice file before completing sale/buy processing; failure after unlink can lose source data.
RealEconomy.verify_integrity deletes files on parse/signature failure instead of quarantining them.
entropy_hint hashes wall-clock time and Python PRNG output and computes byte-distribution entropy over one digest.

save_json uses temp+os.replace, stronger than direct overwrite, but load_json silently returns defaults on corruption and historical pool-truth import trusts matching local log/state files without cryptographic provenance.
Tachyon, quantum, black-hole, tesseract and related labels are names for deterministic/statistical heuristics in this code, not evidence of corresponding physical phenomena.
